inspectedText: Selective excision experiments show that the transformation of medusae into polyps occurs only if differentiated cells of the exumbrellar epidermis and part of the gastrovascular system are present
inspectionLimits: Publisher abstract inspected, not full1996 paper. Historical Mediterranean T.nutricula name is interpreted with modern2016/2019 taxonomy, not applied to every current nutricula population. Tissue evidence supports specialized-cell participation, not an exhaustive cell-fate map.
